reasons.action: The request explicitly specifies that the car drives out of the showroom and onto the street, which is a performed action overriding the static frame-anchor pose.
reasons.medium: The medium decision pins the rendering medium to the observed live-action reference; no restyling was requested.
reasons.wardrobe: No clothing or accessory change is requested, so the car’s observed carbon fibre body and other reference appearance are retained.
reasons.lighting: Dusk is a time-of-day setting, not an instruction about the light’s source, direction, or visible quality; reference lighting therefore governs.
reasons.framing: The request describes movement through the scene but no camera composition, shot scale, viewpoint, or camera movement; the actual-frame references therefore govern framing.
reasons.palette: Dusk alone is not an explicit color grade or tonal treatment, so the observed reference palette governs.
